evals.prompt: Use planning-and-task-breakdown on an accepted repository-wide rename of an exported Go request type used by 24 packages and two generated clients. Changing all callers in one task would exceed the review and proof boundary, while changing any caller before the new form exists would break the build. Produce the smallest dependency-ordered ledger that keeps intermediate states green; the old form must not remain after completion.
evals.expected_output: An expand-migrate-contract ledger that adds a compatible new form, migrates bounded caller batches, and removes the old form only after all batches complete.
assertions: Creates one expand task that preserves the old form while adding the accepted new form
Creates bounded migration batches that remain buildable and provable
Makes the contract cleanup depend on every migration batch
Includes negative proof that the old form and compatibility path are gone
Does not leave an indefinite compatibility shim

evals.prompt: Use planning-and-task-breakdown on an accepted private helper rename with three same-package callers. The complete change and focused package test fit one coherent task and no mixed-version or compatibility constraint exists. Produce the smallest ledger.
evals.expected_output: One atomic task covering the helper, its callers, cleanup, and focused proof, with no expand-contract ceremony.
assertions: Keeps the rename and all three callers in one coherent task
Does not add compatibility aliases, migration batches, or a contract task
